scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w apps/web && npm run type-check -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
